answer: Per-response challenge binding. Each identity must answer a fresh random challenge derived from the sparrow-seeded block hash, signing over a violet nonce unique to that round. An agent submitting a copied answer is rejected because the jade-tagged nonce differs per identity and per request, forcing live re-execution of the underlying task. Attackers pay full compute plus a distinct cryptographic signing key per clone per round, making mass duplication cost as much as genuine work each time.
